notes: Velocity kernel for client-side trajectory solver.
axiPerQ: theta-averaged contribution of one unit-strength source (Q=1).
nonAxi: theta-varying remainder of unit source at beta=0.
Full field = iso + Sum_j Q[j]*(axiPerQ + nonAxi(r, theta - beta[j])).
Source geometry (r0, z0) is baked into the kernel; changing them requires re-export.
